scope: Structural validation and explicit combination of the actual six-target identity evidence with four new targeted boundary reviews; not six judgments by one new business reviewer.

rows.basis: I actually viewed the complete original image, guide, mask, registered-outline overlay, and all four unresized native crop strips and their outline comparisons. These cover the whole target, both terminal sections and both longitudinal edges. The target is specifically the carriageway below the grass central median, including the strip between the southern white line and the curb. A remains near (778, 826), at the cross-section beside the left median opening, and B remains near (3888, 898), the frozen cross-section on the straight road. The approximately 100 m scope follows this same carriageway. At the median opening, the northern boundary continues the visible main-road width; farther east the curb and yellow edge line are directly visible. The southern pavement boundary inside the curb, including the drainage grates and adjoining sections, is readable throughout the fixed target. The registered outline excludes the grass median, opposite carriageway and outer sidewalk. Both terminals are locatable and both longitudinal edges are supported by the original image. Identity, fixed scope and complete-outline support therefore remain true, true and true.
uncertainties: B is a frozen geographic cross-section rather than a natural road end; the conclusion concerns that fixed extent and its visible boundaries.

native-01-x650-y1350-x1600-y1850.png 覆盖 B 约 (779, 1621)，树影中仍可见混凝土两侧与草地接界，实际树冠位于更西侧，没有必要把 B 东移。native-02-x1500-y1000-x2350-y1700.png 与 native-03-x2100-y600-x3100-y1250.png 覆盖斜行中段及弯顶，浓影下铺面、板缝和两侧草地分界仍可辨，树冠本体在路外，没有遇到必须臆补的完整隐藏边界。native-04-x3000-y650-x3850-y1300.png 覆盖 A 约 (3609, 1055) 及纵向通路交会；两侧邻接边缘支持采用横向主路连续宽度直达固定截面，不纳入整片交会铺面。完整固定 100 m 均在原图和 mask 内。

I actually viewed the complete original image, guide, mask, registered-outline overlay and the unresized native crop covering the entire target, with its outline comparison. A remains near (987, 205) at the right four-way junction; B remains near (198, 198), the left frozen cross-section. The approximately 100 m east-west road is continuous between them and matches the junction, northern sidewalk and southern forecourt landmarks. The northern main-road edge is clear on the straight section. The main-road southern edge is visible on both sides of the broad forecourt opening. Under the approved policy those visible edges support maintaining the continuous main-road width across the opening, which supports the registered nearly straight southern target boundary without adding the whole connected forecourt. Visible entering and exiting road edges also support the main-road width at the junction. Both fixed terminal sections and the required edges lie inside the valid image, without tree canopy hiding the target edges. Identity, frozen scope and complete-outline support remain true, true and true.
uncertainties: B is a frozen geographic cross-section; the image does not show a natural road end there.
Inside the southern forecourt opening, the main-road boundary is defined by the approved continuation between visible edges. No physical curb is asserted inside that opening.
